A.desc: the original through the base program path

B.desc: a plain, brighter PWM wash: two pulses (PW 34 / 31 %) through LP12 (KEY TRK 100), mild erosion, wetness L3

C.desc: the soft, hollow colour: a narrower pulse (30 %), an octave-up pulse copy at LEVEL 45, a resonant LP12 at a fixed CUTOFF 78 / RESO 75 (KEY TRK 0), a lighter spring (MIX 95, DRAIN 25)

D.desc: C's colour, wetter (echo FEEDBK 82, MIX 110, DRAIN 38, SIZE 90) and a deeper filter bloom (ENV AMT 100)

E2.desc: B with a deeper erosion (CUTOFF 70, ENV AMT 90, FILTER SUSTAIN 0)

A*.desc: the original's tone with VOLUME alone moved onto the reference (a listening aid)
